name: peertube
title: PeerTube
description: Video hosting on your own domain, federated with the fediverse, with the videos in an S3-compatible bucket (R2).
notes: https://{{domain}} is permanent: every video and account address is tied to it. Buckets: {{bucket}} must be public at {{files_url}} (on R2, a custom domain or r2.dev) with a CORS rule that allows GET and HEAD from https://{{domain}}, or the player can't load videos; {{private_bucket}} must never be public. First sign-in: at its first start PeerTube makes the account root and writes its password once to its log. Open the app's Logs, search for "User password", sign in at https://{{domain}}/login as root, and change the password in My account, Settings. Sign-ups are closed and no email is set up: to send email, add PEERTUBE_SMTP_HOSTNAME, PEERTUBE_SMTP_PORT and PEERTUBE_SMTP_USERNAME to the peertube service's environment (Configure, Compose) and PEERTUBE_SMTP_PASSWORD as its secret, then open sign-ups in Administration if you want them. Transcoding uses up to 3 GB of memory; on a small server, move it to a remote runner on another machine (Administration, Remote runners). Backups: Postgres and PeerTube's volumes (thumbnails, avatars, plugins, settings) every day at 03:00 UTC, keeping 14; PeerTube stops for a few seconds during its backup. The videos are in the bucket, which Caravana doesn't back up. Redis holds only the job queue. Live streaming isn't set up: it needs the RTMP port, which a later version of this template adds.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Domain
inputs.help: Where PeerTube answers. Its DNS must point at this server. It can never change.

inputs.name: admin_email
inputs.label: Admin email
inputs.help: The email of the root account.

inputs.name: s3_endpoint
inputs.label: S3 endpoint
inputs.help: Your bucket provider's S3 address. On R2: https://<account ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.label: Videos bucket
inputs.help: The public bucket for the videos, playlists and captions.

inputs.name: files_url
inputs.label: Videos bucket's public URL
inputs.help: Where browsers read that bucket: its R2 custom domain or r2.dev address.

inputs.name: private_bucket
inputs.label: Private bucket
inputs.help: For users' exports and kept original files. It must never be public.

inputs.name: s3_access_key_id
inputs.label: S3 access key ID
inputs.help: From an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on both buckets.
